summary: Extraction of Kaveri Precision Components' offer letter (Ref KPC/MKT/2026/1187, 30 Sep 2026) covering RFQ lines 0 and 1, with the high-speed variant explicitly declined. Prices and terms are stated in prose paragraphs rather than a table; freight is conditional on a ₹5 lakh despatch value and payment is 50% advance with balance on delivery, which does not match the requested days-from-invoice basis.

cert_assessment.note: Vendor cites the exact required standard ISO 15243 with certificate and issuer; note the certificate expires before the 2026-11-18 need-by date.

cert_assessment.note: Vendor states it is an ISO 9001:2015 certified organisation, i.e. the required supplier quality-system standard; issuing body not named.

ambiguities: Payment terms are 50% advance with balance on delivery, not a credit period in days from invoice date as requested by the RFQ.
Lead time is stated as 30 days from purchase order date without clarifying whether that is dispatch or delivery at Chakan.
The ISO 15243 certificate is stated valid only until 12 November 2026, before the 18 November 2026 need-by date — renewal status should be queried.
Freight is free only for a single despatch above ₹5 lakh; whether the combined order would ship as one despatch is not stated.
GST is extra at 'the applicable rate' — rate not specified.
Issuer of the ISO 9001:2015 certificate is not named.
